title: HACK-3 BULLRUN: Nation-State Subversion vs. the PQC Perimeter — Deterministic Gate Adversarial Battery (6/6 PASS)
description:
Third battery in the HACK adversarial series. Threat model: the NSA BULLRUN playbook (declassified 2013) — subverted standards (Dual_EC_DRBG), protocol downgrade, library attestation subversion, key-lifecycle abuse, process bypass, and harvest-now-decrypt-later. Explicit constraint: the lattice math is untouchable; every falsifier lands on the operational surface.

Six falsifiers were preregistered and committed (commit 56351d2) BEFORE any run, frozen manifest sha256 f2135c98...ac2b7, no edits after commit. Adjudication is a deterministic gate with no LLM in the decision path; all injections are synthetic and hub-local.

Result: 6/6 predicted verdicts, 0 violations, 1 deliberate critical hold (FC-4 retired-key resurrection failed closed and resolved only under a human ACK on the authorized channel). Thesis demonstrated: there is no implementation seam between the math and the enforcement — every route to the crypto passes through the frozen gate.

Bundle: preregistration spec, deterministic battery harness, run receipt (sha256 3c0e804b...f29059), runlog, and evidence bundle (sha256 560bd31b...086e64).

This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All systems are experimental and may contain defects.
